description: Search the web and get the top 3 pages back as clean Markdown in one call, ready for an LLM. Built for AI agents and RAG: no API key, account or sign-up. Use it when: You need to answer a question from current web pages, not just a list of links. Not for: A plain list of search results; the Google web search results node is cheaper per link. Returns: The top 3 results, each with title, URL, description and the full page text as Markdown. Typical time: about 18 s. Price: $0.017 per search (up to 3 pages), charged only on success. One call = up to 3 pages.
